title: Case 5 - Edit shipping address
description: Shows conflict resolution between UX and technical agents.

request.title: Edit shipping address
request.storyText: As a user, I want to edit my shipping address directly from my profile with a simple inline form so I can make quick changes without navigating away. The edit should take immediate effect on all my orders, including those already being prepared for shipment. The form should provide direct autocomplete suggestions using the Google Maps API. The system should not ask for additional confirmation steps — the experience should be as simple and quick as possible.
